description: VERIFIED subset of the 273/multi-category doping cascade (tools/doping) results, copied to the vm repo so they are queryable here. The FULL registered cascade (39+ compounds) lives in doping_cascade.json on gabia (kserver116-27) and is pending PAT sync. This file holds compounds whose champion/convergence/EOS/elastic were directly read from the gabia run dirs and confirmed. NOTE: the trivalent M3+ series (Al/Sc/Ga/In/Y/Gd/Sm/Nd/La oxides, ionic-radius sweep) is in db/properties/doping_cascade_trivalent_M3.json (pulled 2026-06-15).
_source: gabia:/data/work/runs/multi_category_2026_05_26_v23/<compound>_<x>/  (cascade git_commit 9ce6ca3, UMA-s-1p1 task=omat, run 2026-06-07). Champion xyz also at gabia:/data/work/repo/db/structures/doping/<compound>_<x>_champion.xyz.

method_notes.score_fields: de_post_anneal = energy/atom vs baseline AFTER anneal (eV/atom, negative = more stable than undoped baseline). dV_anneal_pct = volume change pre->post anneal. converged_post_anneal = champion geometry converged.
method_notes.elastic: UMA-s-1p1 relaxed-ion Cij -> Voigt-Reuss-Hill (B_hill/G_hill = B_VRH/G_VRH); E_VRH = 9BG/(3B+G). Absolute UMA elastic runs HIGH vs experimental AFM/UPE (12-22 GPa) — compare WITHIN cascade (UMA-vs-UMA) only.
method_notes.eos: UMA-s-1p1 Birch-Murnaghan B0 (hydrostatic). Distinct quantity from elastic B_VRH (harmonic Cij); EOS B0 < B_VRH typically (~2x for soft argyrodites).

_full_audit_2026_06_09: 14 dopants x 3 concentrations + Sc2O3 x002 = 41 champions, ALL converged. See docs/cascade/cascade_dopants_2026_06_09.md for the full table + interpretation. Key findings: 38/41 champions on Li_24g, 3/41 on Li_48h (Li2O all, Cu2O x002/x010, Ag2O x010, Na2O x005), 0/41 on P_4b. Top by formation energy: Sc2O3 (-0.974) > Al2O3 cluster (-0.79..-0.82) > Mn/Co/Ca/Ba cluster (-0.57..-0.66) > rest (-0.48..-0.56). Top by softness (low E_VRH = coating candidate): Sc2O3_x002 18.7 > Al2O3_x005 29.3 > Li2O_x005 32.4 > MnO_x005 32.6 > NiO_x010 33.9. Three cases (MnO_x002, CoO_x010, ZnO_x010) returned B0=0 (EOS fit failure) but Cij/E_VRH still good. Markdown owns the narrative; this JSON holds queryable headline numbers per dopant.

Sc2O3.verdict: STRONGEST cascade winner. Highest formation favorability (-0.974) AND lowest E_VRH (18.7) -> most promising single coating candidate. Only x=0.02 currently; x=0.05/0.10 follow-up recommended.

Al2O3.champion_site_all_x: Li_24g (Al3+ -> Li site, DONOR) + O -> S_16e

x005._note: softest Al2O3, best low-modulus coating candidate

Al2O3.verdict: Robust across all 3 x. x005 is softest (E_VRH 29.3, B0 18.1) and remains the Al2O3 coating-candidate pick.

MnO.verdict: Strong dE cluster (-0.64..-0.66), minimal lattice strain, soft E. x005 best balanced; x002 B0 fit failed (Cij still good).

CoO.verdict: Mid cluster, stiff. x010 B0 fit failed.

NiO.verdict: Direction consistent with earlier db NiO entry (0.81/0.85/0.70). x010 softest.

MgO.verdict: Mg prefers co-Cl-enrichment at x<=0.05. Large |dV| (-7 to -9%).

Li2O.champion_site_all_x: Li_48h (Li dopant goes to smaller site)
Li2O.verdict: Self-similar substitution (Li+->Li+) prefers smaller 48h sites in all x.

Cu2O.verdict: Small Cu+ prefers Li_48h at low+high x but Li_24g at x=0.05 (concentration crossover). Stiff E.

Ag2O.verdict: Like Cu+: small monovalent cation, 48h at high x.

Na2O.verdict: Weakest dE cluster. 48h at x=0.05 is a tie-breaker, not a chemistry signal.

ZnO.verdict: Stiff, weakest dE. x010 B0 fit failed.

coating_candidates_ranked_by_E_VRH._purpose: For Hyundai low-modulus coating-layer goal (weekly report). Sorted ascending in E_VRH (softer first); only champions with both favorable dE and good EOS+elastic data.

rank1_Sc2O3_x002.note: best overall: softest AND strongest formation
